comparison.objective: Turn look-alike medicine cartons to inspect hidden labels and dispense only the 10 mg pack; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Active visual inspection, reorientation, strength discrimination, and safe selection versus narrow-tool alignment, bimanual impact control, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Correct 10 mg carton dispensed, with any 5 mg carton causing zero; unchecked correct dispensing earns only partial credit. Candidate requires four safe fractures and all tangs contained.
comparison.reason: Hidden-label inspection and medication selection test a different perceptual-safety ability from precision impact tooling.
